enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash and dressing (after Member 1 finishes in the bathroom)
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Wait for Member 1 to exit. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on sink tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Wrap towel around waist. Open cabinet. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Comb hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast together with Member 1, drinking coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread, butter. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Cook eggs in pan. Toast bread. Pour milk and coffee. Set table. Sit with Member 1. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Say to Member 1: 'Good morning.' Discuss day's schedule. Finish eating. Clear plates. Rinse plates. Place in sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for work and checking schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Change into work clothes. Open computer. Check email. Review schedule. Pack bag with laptop, notebook, pen. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Turn off desk lamp. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at office on arts administration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check meetings. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss project with colleagues. Make phone calls. Draft reports. Print documents. File papers. Take short break. Get water. Return to desk. Continue working.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Check phone. Talk with colleague. Finish eating. Return tray. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office.

Sit at desk. Open computer. Resume work. Attend afternoon meeting. Present ideas. Take notes. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Review documents. Update project plan. Coordinate with team. Take short break. Get water. Return to desk. Organize files. Prepare for next day. Shut down computer. Pack bag.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Greet Member 1. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil and ingredients. Stir. Add spices. Simmer. Set table. Sit with Member 1. Eat dinner. Drink water. Talk with Member 1. Finish eating. Clear plates. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash plates. Rinse plates. Place in dish rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in dish rack. Wash pots. Rinse pots. Place in dish rack. Drain sink. Pick up cloth. Wipe counters. Wipe stove. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Talk with Member 1.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Sketch initial ideas. Adjust brush settings. Draw outlines. Add colors. Use stylus. Save file. Check email for client feedback. Reply to client. Continue drawing. Adjust details. Save again. Export image. Close software. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and personal time while Member 1 showers
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Change into pajamas. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read. Check phone. Set alarm. Put phone on nightstand. Turn on space heater. Adjust blanket. Lie down. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
